card.name: Words just before drug-class nouns
card.fires_on: Words that sit right before a drug-class noun such as contraceptive, users, or blocking drugs. Most often 'oral' in oral contraceptive, 'channel' in calcium channel blockers, and 'users' after CHC.

modes.label: Oral contraceptive wording
modes.description: 'oral' or 'contraceptive' or 'users' in risk statements about birth control pills.
modes.example: An increased risk of myocardial infarction has been attributed to<< oral>> contraceptive use.
